$comment: Every official page opened to build the Chennai civic knowledge base. status: 'verified' = page loaded and stated the fact; 'loads' = page loaded but the specific function (e.g. a JavaScript form) could not be confirmed; 'unreachable' = could not be opened (reason recorded).
